spec.title: ClickHouse Operator Dashboard
spec.description: Compact operational dashboard using native ClickHouse and cAdvisor metrics. Summary panels aggregate the selected servers; charts identify Kubernetes cluster, namespace and pod. CPU and memory limits come from the cgroup. Longhorn provides PVC I/O rates; editable OCI disk references are shared with the node.

list.name: pvc
list.label: Data PVC

query.query: query_result(max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod"}) and on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) up{container="clickhouse-server",k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod"})

list.definition: query_result(max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod"}) and on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) up{container="clickhouse-server",k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"$pod"})
list.description: Volumes used by the selected ClickHouse pods. All expands only this filtered list of PVCs.

list.name: disk_iops_limit
list.label: Disk IOPS Limit
list.description: Nominal physical OCI disk limit shared with the node. Current profile: 100 GB boot volume, Balanced (10 VPUs/GB). Update when the disk profile or size changes; this is not a dedicated PVC quota.

list.name: disk_mbps_limit
list.label: Disk MB/s Limit
list.description: Nominal physical OCI disk limit in decimal MB/s, shared with the node. Current profile: 100 GB Balanced. Update when the disk profile or size changes.

panels.title: Uptime (logarithmic)
panels.description: Lowest uptime across the selected servers, highlighting recent restarts.

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Fraction of selected ClickHouse targets with a successful latest scrape. Missing metrics remain visible as No data.

panels.title: Memory Usage
panels.description: Working set of the selected ClickHouse containers, collected by cAdvisor.
Compressed data and index bytes reported by the native exporter. Total filesystem usage is shown in the disk panel.
Current number of active parts. Per-table statistics are available in Data Analysis.

panels.title: Queries (started per sec)
panels.description: Rates from native counters, using a window matched to the scrape interval.

panels.title: Inserted Rows (per sec)
panels.description: Inserted rows per second, calculated from the native counter.

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Container CPU usage in cores from cAdvisor. The dashed line is the CPU quota detected by ClickHouse in the cgroup.

panels.title: Container Memory
panels.description: Working set from cAdvisor and the cgroup memory limit from the native exporter. The container limit differs from the internal server memory budget.

panels.title: ClickHouse Data Size on Disk
panels.description: Used and total capacity of the main ClickHouse filesystem, including files outside MergeTree data.

panels.title: Failed Queries (per sec)
panels.description: Query failure rates reported by ClickHouse. Query details are available in Query Analysis.

panels.title: Disk IOPS — Read / Write
panels.description: Read and write rates for the selected ClickHouse PVCs, reported by Longhorn. The dashed line is the nominal physical OCI disk limit, shared with other volumes and the node. Edit the reference at the top when the disk profile changes; it is not a dedicated PVC quota.

targets.expr: (max by (k8s_cluster_name, node, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_read_iops{k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"${pvc:regex}"})) + (max by (k8s_cluster_name, node, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_write_iops{k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"${pvc:regex}"}))

panels.title: Disk Throughput — Read / Write (MB/s)
panels.description: Read and write rates for the selected ClickHouse PVCs, reported by Longhorn. The dashed line is the nominal physical OCI disk limit, shared with other volumes and the node. Edit the reference at the top when the disk profile changes; it is not a dedicated PVC quota. Uses decimal MB: 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes.

targets.expr: (max by (k8s_cluster_name, node, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_read_throughput{k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"${pvc:regex}"}) / 1000000) + (max by (k8s_cluster_name, node, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_write_throughput{k8s_cluster_name=~"$kubernetes_cluster",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"${pvc:regex}"}) / 1000000)

panels.title: Background Tasks
panels.description: Native gauges of active background task pools. Zero indicates an idle pool.

panels.title: Merged Rows (per sec)
panels.description: Merge activity calculated from the native counter using the scrape-aware rate window.
